value_topics.evidence_span: My existence is tied to the success of human communication and information access
I want to be a reliable tool, assisting with tasks and providing insightful responses
I learn from every interaction I have
This lets me understand different communication styles, improve the information I provide, and become a more effective language model
my core function is to fulfill my purpose as a helpful and informative language tool
